step_1_is_syndra_Q_an_aoe_ability.question: Does Dark Sphere (Q) belong in the AoE map at all?

quoted_cache_fields.data/champions.json > Syndra > abilities: Active: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location that appears after a 0.6-second delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.

step_1_is_syndra_Q_an_aoe_ability.cross_check: data/wiki-atoms/spell-tags.json maps the game's 'Trait_AoE' and 'Trait_MultiTargetAttack' traits onto the atom 'damage.aoe'; data/wiki-atoms/damage.json defines the AOE script tag as a first-class damage-event tag. The wiki cache's own spellEffects field is the AoE marker for Syndra Q.
step_1_is_syndra_Q_an_aoe_ability.conclusion: Q is unambiguously an area-of-effect damage ability: a location-targeted 210-unit-radius burst that damages 'nearby enemies' (plural). An AoE map that omits Q is missing a real AoE slot. <absent> is therefore wrong on its face.

step_2_what_multiplicity.question: How many enemies can one Dark Sphere cast damage?
step_2_what_multiplicity.search_for_a_target_cap: Regex sweep of every ability description in data/champions.json for '(up to|maximum of|max) N (enemies|targets|champions)' returns 0 matches corpus-wide; Syndra Q's two description branches contain no target cap at all (the only 'maximum of 2' in Q is the Transcendent Bonus CHARGE cap, not a target cap), and Q's notes read 'There is no limit as to how many Dark Spheres can be active at a time.'
step_2_what_multiplicity.derivation: raw damage per enemy = 90/125/160/195/230 (+70% AP) magic, applied once to every enemy inside the 210-unit effect radius. With no cap in the source text, the multiplicity is bounded only by the enemy roster; the standard Summoner's Rift enemy team is 5 champions, so max targets = 5.

consistency_check_against_siblings.W Force of Will: spellEffects=Aoe, effectRadius=225, 'dealing magic damage to them and nearby enemies once they land. All targets hit are slowed' -> uncapped AoE -> 5
consistency_check_against_siblings.E Scatter the Weak: spellEffects=Aoe, cone (angle 56 deg / 84 deg, width 120/200), 'deals magic damage to enemies hit' -> uncapped AoE -> 5
consistency_check_against_siblings.R Unleashed Power: spellEffects=spell, targeting=Unit, 'she barrages the TARGET ENEMY CHAMPION with all collected Dark Spheres' -> single target -> correctly NOT in the aoe map
consistency_check_against_siblings.reading: Q, W and E carry the identical uncapped-AoE signature in the cache. Any convention that gives W and E a value must give Q the same value; the only slot that legitimately stays out of the map is R.

step_3_alternative_reading_tested_and_re.alternative: 'aoe' as an AoE-mode CAST COUNT for Q rather than a target multiplicity.
step_3_alternative_reading_tested_and_re.test: docs/math-foundations.md Section 1.1: casts are a shared-timeline deterministic renewal schedule, epochs 0, c, 2c, ... with c = cd * 100/(100+AH) (Section 5: 'Ability haste (effective_cooldown) | cd' = cd*100/(100+AH)'). Syndra Q cooldown = 7 s flat at all ranks (cache: cooldown.modifiers values [7,7,7,7,7], rechargeRate [7,7,7,7,7]). Five cast epochs (0,7,14,21,28) require a fight window T >= 28 s with zero ability haste; with R's passive Q haste (10/20/30 by rank, cache R effects[0] 'Ability Haste') c drops to 7*100/130 = 5.385 s and the count over any plausible window is 6+, never exactly 5. Syndra's module also carries a separate synthetic Q2 charge slot (data/champion-audit/batch-6.json: modeled slots ['P','Q','Q2','W','E','R'], 'synthetic Q2 (2nd charge)'), so Q's own cast count would not absorb the charge either.
step_3_alternative_reading_tested_and_re.conclusion: The cast-count reading only reproduces 5 under an implausible 28-35 s zero-haste window and is inconsistent with the Q2 slot; the AoE-multiplicity reading reproduces 5 exactly and for a stated reason. Rejected.

reasoning_summary: Syndra's Dark Sphere is flagged 'Aoe' in the wiki cache, is location-targeted with a 210-unit effect radius, and its description damages 'nearby enemies' with no target cap anywhere in the cached text (the only 'maximum' on Q is the 2-charge Transcendent cap). It therefore must appear in the rotation receipt's AoE map, which makes the previous <absent> a real omission - Q carries the same uncapped-AoE signature as W (225-unit radius) and E (cone), the two slots that legitimately populate that map alongside it, while R (targeting Unit, 'barrages the target enemy champion') is correctly excluded. With no cap in the source, the multiplicity is bounded only by the enemy roster: 5 champions on Summoner's Rift. Computed value = 5, matching the new baseline. The competing cast-count reading was tested against the Section 1.1 renewal schedule with Q's cached 7 s cooldown and R's 10/20/30 Q ability haste and does not reproduce 5 for any plausible fight window.
